class.description: Nav2 Planner Plugin for Move Base Flex. This plugin forwards planning requests from MBF to Nav2's ComputePathToPose action server. It provides a map-less interface by delegating all planning to Nav2's navigation stack.

Nav2 Controller Plugin for Move Base Flex. This plugin forwards path following requests from MBF to Nav2's FollowPath action server. It provides a map-less interface by delegating all control to Nav2's navigation stack.
